ceiling: Configuration validation only, so it confirms secret references, the delivery mechanism and the plaintext flag are declared; it does not read any secret store.
offer: Reference the secret authority and inject through workload identity where available. Declared plaintext values in configuration cross the secret boundary and are rejected.

minimal.reason: List secrets by reference to the authority that holds them. Values in configuration cross the secret boundary, so point to the store.

mid.reason: Declare how secrets reach the workload, such as workload identity. An undefined path invites plaintext files, so name the mechanism.

maximal.reason: Set plaintext secret values to false. A literal value in configuration is a leak, so remove it and rotate the secret.
